description: Random rectangular grid partition with one region-cluster carved into a polygon 'island', outlined over filled parts; monochrome on white
notable: Base of the domain-polygon system: partitions a grid, then boolean-clips a polygon 'island' from a selection of cells

description: Subdivided grid of colored rectangles whose row/column lines interpolate between randomly distorted states, making the grid breathe
notable: Animates by lerping each grid vertex between randomly offset column/row positions across cycles

description: Gapped grid of OKLCH-harmony-colored rectangles animating between distorted grid states, separated by thick background outlines
notable: Uses ColorPaletteGenerator harmonies in OKLCH; picks the lightest color as background

description: Static subdivided grid where each rectangle is filled with a left-to-right linear gradient between palette colors
Outlines only: distorted rectangular grid animating between warped row/column positions, black stroke on white
Static subdivided grid of rectangles each filled with a horizontal gradient across uchu hues on a dark ground
A few largest regions reduced to bold flat color blocks over a distorting grid; Ellsworth Kelly-style hard-edge reduction
notable: Keeps only the largest cells as color blocks; color source switches between uchu, chromotome, and random palettes

description: Domain color field rasterized into small tiles that shuffle positions and animate scattering then re-forming
notable: Reads back the rendered field via getImageData, samples each tile's center color, then lerps tiles between ordered and shuffled layouts

description: Distorted rectangular grid with each region filled by a horizontal gradient (uchu or random palette), animated over cycles
Bare structural view of the domain partition: outlined rectangles over faint underlying grid lines, monochrome
notable: Exposes the raw scaffolding of the domain system with no fills

description: Mousedown steps the domain-system generator through its region-combining stages, drawn in a rough hand-sketched style
notable: Drives the generator one optimization step per click and renders with roughjs for a sketchy pencil look

description: Abstract rectangle partition reinterpreted as macOS desktop UI: windows with traffic-light buttons, toolbar, and vector-network nodes
notable: Maps domain regions onto fake app chrome — windows, buttons, toolbars — using Radix UI color scales

description: Animated macOS-desktop reading of the partition: windows and UI parts warp as the grid distorts between cycles
macOS-window rendering of the partition with visible grid lines and a quarter of regions promoted to windows
Tessellated polygons tiling the domains, filled as button-like parts and animated over a distorting grid
Colored polygon-island construction: regions and clipped parts filled from a random palette, with an optional figure/ground invert
Grid of dots displaced by iterated noise domain-warping, colored by a subtractive-color ramp; animated fBm-style flow
notable: Classic iterated domain-warping (position fed through successive noise offsets with falloff) rendered as a displaced dot field

description: Interactive Coulomb electric-field: draggable +/- charges, a grid of field arrows, and traced flux lines with arrowheads on black
notable: Real Coulomb math with complex-number vectors; tweakpane controls to add/remove charges and trace flux

description: Interactive charge field with flux lines drawn as tapering variable-width ribbons, gradient-colored by the nearest particle
notable: Stroke width scales inversely with field magnitude — thick where sparse, thin where dense — for a flowing look

description: Interactive charge field whose flux lines render as multi-bristle brush strokes for a painterly, dry-brush look
notable: Each field line is split into offset alpha-faded bristles that fan out with stroke width, mimicking a paintbrush

description: Packed circles each filled with double Fermat spirals stitched as animated dashed strokes; embroidery aesthetic
notable: pack-spheres for circle packing; dashed strokes with animated dash offset read as running stitches

description: Dual-arm Fermat spiral of colored dots with a traveling sine pulse animating their radii; split-complementary color ramp
notable: Two counter-rotating Fermat arms; a phase-shifted sine wave sweeps a pulse of size along the spiral

description: Golden-ratio-spaced grid lines converging on an off-center origin, with corner triangles filled, over film grain; near-monochrome
notable: Grid spacing grows by the golden ratio away from a focal origin (dense near it), giving a perspective-like pull; salt-pepper + white grain overlay

description: Golden-ratio focal grid whose origin drifts on looping noise; corner triangles and film grain, near-monochrome
notable: Animated variant: the focal origin wanders via looping 2D noise so the whole golden-ratio grid re-forms each frame
